title: Gerry Zhao — The Ascent
description: Photographs, experiments in light, a mailbox and a guestbook, laid out as camps on one mountain. Scroll or click to climb.

intro.title:
Chasing light.
Keeping moments.
intro.description: A little space for the things that catch my eye — on the street, in the quiet, and somewhere in between. Five camps on one mountain.

camps.title: About
camps.description: Who is climbing, and why the mountain.

camps.title: Photography
camps.description: Fleeting light, familiar strangers, and the small scenes worth keeping.

camps.title: The Phantom
camps.description: Experiments in light, depth and place: a thousand little points that grew into a million.

camps.title: g3mail
camps.description: Keeping in touch. A free @g3rry.com mailbox, open to anyone who climbs this far.

camps.title: Say hello
camps.description: Every climber signs the book at the top. Leave a note for whoever comes next.

below.title: The Heart
below.description: Every lantern on the mountain is lit from here. The rock keeps the site as it would have been in eight other years, layer under layer.

above.title: Moonward
above.description: Past the last flag the trail turns into stars. Nothing is built up here yet: only the quiet, and room.
